english.title: Fly an aircraft without there being in force a valid certificate of airworthiness
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) flew an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..) when

(A)_[there was not in force for the aircraft a certificate of airworthiness issued or rendered valid under the law of the country in which the aircraft was registered or the state of the operator]_
(B)_[conditions subject to which a certificate of airworthiness was issued were not complied with in that **(..SPECIFY CONDITION(S) AND NATURE OF NON-COMPLIANCE..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 16(1), 241(7) of and Schedule 13 Part C to the Air Navigation Order 2009.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fly an aircraft
without there being in force a valid certificate of airworthiness to which attached conditions were complied with
